Svensk privatbostad: kontraktsdatum styr: Swedish private home: the contract date determines the sale year. The asset’s tax cost basis is used as the complete deductible basis. Do not add the same costs again.
Svensk skatt efter utflyttning stöder in: Swedish tax after emigration does not support public service, maritime income or other special cases.
Svenska inkomstskatteregler 2025. Kommun: Swedish income tax rules for 2025. Municipal tax includes regional tax. Burial fees and any religious community fees are entered separately. The same selections are used for both adults. The forecast assumes May 1 of the year following the income year for annual settlement unless a payment date is entered. The actual date depends on the tax notice. Enter the property sale’s tax notice dates on the property.
Uppskovet är uppskjuten vinst, inte skat: The deferral is the deferred gain, not the tax on the gain. Enter the remaining nominal amount.
Uppskovets status måste motsvara den tid: The deferral status must match the earlier review.
Valfritt prognosantagande, inte en fasts: Optional forecast assumption, not an established due date. Actual payment dates take precedence. A date is needed only if the annual tax balance is non-zero.
